ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the graph of the linear function $y=kx+b$, what is the solution set of the linear inequality $kx+b>0$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the graph, it is known that $y$ decreases as $x$ increases, and when $x<2$, the line is above the x-axis,\\
therefore, the solution set for $kx+b>0$ is: $\boxed{x<2}$.
